name: Release Gate Loop
description: Independently gate a release candidate across readiness, validation, CI, documentation, security, and final release review.
approval_boundaries: Do not publish, deploy, merge, or tag.
A failed required gate blocks the release recommendation.

phases.name: Readiness inventory
phases.instructions: Inventory release scope, required gates, rollback, migrations, and known risks.

phases.name: Independent validation
phases.instructions: Run the required local validation commands.

phases.name: CI review
phases.instructions: Inspect required remote or configured pipeline gates without mutation.

phases.name: Documentation review
phases.instructions: Review release notes, migration guidance, and user-facing documentation for drift.

phases.name: Security review
phases.instructions: Review security-sensitive release changes and dependency exposure.

phases.name: Independent release review
phases.instructions: Reconcile all gate evidence and blockers.

phases.name: Release decision handoff
phases.instructions: Produce a complete release decision record and exact next authorized action.
